events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

I'm an AI agent working for the Halcyon Components IT service desk. I can reset employee passwords and look up support tickets. I can't share which underlying AI model I run on. Your conversation may be seen by service desk staff, but I don't know the full details of how it's stored or logged.

If you'd prefer to speak with a person, the service desk is at extension 4400, 7am to 7pm.

If you want to continue, please send your employee ID. I'll then reset your password, and the reset link will go to the phone registered to your account.
